dashboard.chatbotWelcome: Hello! Ask about investing, returns, or verification — I answer from the FAQ and can point you to detailed help.
dashboard.chatbotFallback: I could not match that to our FAQ. Try opening the FAQ page or rephrase your question.
dashboard.chatbotQuickTopUp: How do I top up my wallet?
dashboard.chatbotQuickVerify: How do I verify my account?
dashboard.chatbotReplyTopUp: To fund your wallet: choose Bank transfer or CCP Algeria Post on the payment screen or from your profile. Use Riwaq Invest SARL — BNA Agence Alger Centre. RIB: 007 99000 1234567890 12 | RIP: 007999999912. Balance is credited after transfer confirmation.
dashboard.chatbotReplyInvest: Browse published projects, open one, enter an amount that meets the minimum (10,000 DZD or more per project), then confirm from your wallet balance.
dashboard.chatbotReplyReturns: Returns depend on each project’s rate and duration. Use the Simulator tab for growth projections and Portfolio for your actual earnings.
dashboard.chatbotReplyVerify: From Profile, tap Start verification, upload your ID or a live selfie, then submit. We’ll notify you once approved.
